conditions: Sequential public-game trials; 30 simulated players first, then 7 simulated players plus up to 1 observing human. Not a controlled rendering benchmark.
reportedSymptomInLargeTrial: After initially working, the user reported that the game became unusable and controls stopped responding while the simulation continued.
conclusion: The smaller load had substantially lower measured request latency and no failed network requests. The user reported that it still stuttered but remained controllable. The cause of the complete input lock in the larger trial and of remaining stutter is not established by these measurements.
reportedExperienceInSmallTrial: Still stutters, but remains controllable (user selected feedback option 2).
